verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for Pulumi, since Pulumi Cloud stores state and history, but the evidence documents no retention settings, history purging, or data-deletion controls. The DIY backend (state kept in your own S3/Azure Blob/GCS bucket) and the self-hosting option are adjacent data-location features; any retention or deletion there would come from the host storage platform, not from Pulumi.
